mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase vitamin C levels by reducing metabolism, and high-dose vitamin C may reduce ritonavir bioavailability through pH-dependent effects on absorption.
action: Monitor for vitamin C toxicity symptoms with high-dose supplementation; avoid excessive vitamin C intake (>2000 mg daily) in patients taking ritonavir; maintain consistent dosing patterns.
